g.text: .NET — stable ILogger integration and original timestamp preservation
Enable Information-level logging for category Lifecycle.OpenTelemetry.
Initial Timestamp and ObservedTimestamp = SDK wall time
Match library category and timestamp marker
Set Timestamp from original event ticks
OTLP exporter maps EventId.Name to native event_name.
Batching, if configured, starts after timestamp restoration.
Invalid inputs fail before state changes. Ordinary sink failures are contained;
previous/current state is retained. Fatal runtime failures are not deliberately caught.
No experimental EmitLog API, reflection, or library-owned background thread is used.
